study: CFDefect-v3 expanded multi-task and normal-only benchmark
status: configuration fixed before any v3 test evaluation

training.checkpoint_selection: 0.5 development AUROC + 0.3 positive-example Dice + 0.2 type macro-F1
training.normal_only_checkpoint_selection: fixed official iteration budget; no defective validation labels
training.training_drop_last_note: The shuffled last incomplete microbatch is omitted to avoid a singleton BatchNorm batch; all validation and evaluation records are retained.

evaluation.cross_script: Latin source families, three geometric types only
evaluation.calibration_unit: maximum benign-view score per base glyph, grouped across combining marks
evaluation.bootstrap: 1000 base-glyph resamples within observed test source families; conditional on those families
evaluation.test_access: all run configurations, code, data and pretrained checkpoints are frozen before the first v3 test scoring; no test-based selection

known_limits: Geometry feature conditioning is an ablation, not established methodological novelty
EfficientAD and other additional methods are not included in this package
No expert study or claim of final publication readiness
existing_campaigns: Read only; never overwritten or deleted
